DetailedComments: We power our cooling devices  equally spread out across our utility source. All of our cooling devices are grouped together per colo and powered on or close to the same power panel. Some on main boards and other on feeder boards. For the ones on the feeder boards if we lost the main breaker, we have no backup. The question is asking for N when all of the electrical connections are single path from the ATS. This means that as long as the ATS has dual sources then the devices have dual sources. I bring this up as alot of our equipment was designed to have dual sources supplied, and we do not have that infrastructue inplace.
